narrative:
Delaware County has 169,802 registered voters, with 16.4% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 30.2% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 45.0%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 14.8 percentage points. Gen X are the largest generational cohort at 28.8% of registrants. Registration is trending bluer in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean -0.2% D−R vs -24.6% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
